reviews.title: In love
reviews.text:
I honestly can’t live without it. Every single track feels like it was created with so much care, intention, and attention to detail. You can truly tell how much work went into each one.

The voices, the music, the 3D sound design, the instruments, the atmosphere… everything is thoughtfully crafted to immerse you in the experience. No two tracks feel the same. Each one has its own personality, making it so much easier to stay present instead of feeling like you’re listening to the same meditation over and over.

As someone with ADHD, this app has been life-changing. My mind usually struggles to stay focused, but these sessions keep me engaged and help me connect with the moment in a way that very few apps ever have.

I’m incredibly grateful for the passion, creativity, and care that clearly go into every track. Thank you for creating something so beautiful.

reviews.title: Peace for my anxious perimenopausal mind
reviews.text: A therapist recommended this app, and it has been a huge improvement in the quality of my life. I listen sometimes with my eyes closed, but more often with an open soft gaze during difficult moments. (After a tough conversation, during my long commute, completing a frustrating chore). I used to think too much and work myself up, but with these audio tracks I can unwind and reconnect to the moment. I love Mindspa so much!

reviews.title: 2 year review
reviews.text: I reviewed this app a few years ago when I first started using it. It was awesome then, and it continues to be awesome. I still love it and use it almost every day. Every release they add new and helpful features, so it’s getting better and better over time. I know it is a big spend, but it is worth it. In fact, my husband wanted to save money and not renew last year and just listen to the free ones but within a few weeks, we had renewed and he is now listening to the entire library again in order. There are a lot of meditation apps out there, but we really like the variety of this one. And the soothing vocals and nature sounds. You won’t like all of them, but that’s ok! There’s so many more to listen to and you can build a favorites list, which is what I do.

reviews.title: deeply grateful
reviews.text:
I’m thrilled because this app is helping me dive back into a meditation practice that I know I need but have been avoiding. I’ve felt resistant to sitting in order to focus only on the breath. So, when I came across it, I was intrigued by this app. It had me considering how specific sensory focus could make a lot of sense in conjunction with a breathwork practice.  I also appreciated the idea of a scientific approach that might progressively create cognitive connections; might increase intuition. 

And the free trial had me immediately convinced! I reached out to support with some questions, a touch of constructive criticism and a request for help in bypassing the free trial so that I could pay for full access. From support, I received the most prompt, kind and useful responses. It further solidified to me that this is a service of value. It’s led by people who care to spread something good and will show it.

The app is equally as fulfilling. I find it to be a really pleasing platform for the eyes and the ears.  The artwork is breathtaking. The binaural beats with the sounds and music massage and tickle my brain. I’m drawn to it. I can focus on it. After several of the Sound Journeys, I feel an ability to focus coming back. The instant progress has me feeling joy at the return of an ability to release without following all of the occurring thoughts. I’m deeply grateful for this app and that return.

The intros to each “sound journey” are pedantic and ridiculous.  I’d gladly take a refund for the time I have left on my year membership because I sure won’t be using it.

reviews.title: I’m seeing results and I love using it!
reviews.text:
I didn’t like this app at first. I’ve been using binaural beats for my daily meditation practice for awhile now. This took some getting use to because of the added music and nature sounds implemented in some of the sound journeys. The intro felt challenging for me too. I guess sometimes I’m in a hurry to start relaxing. That said… I now think the intros are essential in getting you into the mindset of meditation. I really love how comforting the voice is. It uses a recording of your voice mixed with the voice they have. I really love that! My meditations are sooo deep and vivid using this app. Sometimes it feels like a heavy trip. Things I’ve noticed after using this for 2 months.
*increase in optimism 
*I don’t easily react as much as I use to. It’s like I think a bit before answering or reacting to something that makes me upset. 
* the things I’m trying to manifest are slowly happening. 
*I am sleeping better 
*I am less moody. I find that I’m thinking with a positive perspective instead of being critical or negative. 
*my distractions are getting easier to avoid. For instance… I hate social media and since using this app. I find it much easier to avoid because I hate how I feel after I use it. Before I would go on knowing how crappy I would feel. Now, it’s much easier to avoid. I went from being on it 2 hours a day to 15 a min a week(my Sunday check in day).

Everyone has to try different types of meditation practices until they find the right one for them. I also did TM for years and I found it doable, but hard to stick with it. I look forward to using this app. This one has been a game changer for me.
